purpose: All 23 distinct eligible CT20 initial prescriptions for subsequent design-space exploration; no overall winner
scope: Geometric constraints are sampled and qualified. Wave output has separate conditional/underresolved status. No global-optimum, manufacturing, or Zemax equivalence claim.

selection_pool.presentation_order: glass position, material order, source seed ID

provenance.limits: Only paraxial power and sampled nonintersection prepared. No claim of NA, image-height, throughput, RGB correction or MTF feasibility.

center_thickness_at_most20mm.requirement: <=20mm each; exact floating-point comparison, no positive tolerance

aperture_fit.policy: Coupled mode: equal front/back radius, capped by smaller original face. Independent mode: each face capped by its own original radius. Reserve max(0.30mm,2% of maximum sampled footprint). Front-diameter50 first front face remains exactly25mm radius; coupled mode keeps both first-element faces25mm.
aperture_fit.limitation: Sampled nonnegative Y fields in a rotationally symmetric system. No rigorous extremum proof between fields/rings/azimuths and no manufacturing tolerance allocation. Dense downstream qualification remains necessary.
aperture_fit.mechanical_profile: Only clear semi-diameters are specified. Mechanical outer diameter, edge/chamfer or tapered solid profile is unspecified; independent clear faces are not manufacturing certification. The wave model treats its declared last clear surface extent as the boundary constraint; moving that boundary with identical rays is model sensitivity, not a physical improvement.
aperture_fit.reason: All sampled statuses and transmitted optical histories preserved

selection.interpretation: all eligible distinct parents retained; score chooses only a same-parent checkpoint, not an overall ranking

seed_generation.limits: Only paraxial power and sampled nonintersection prepared. No claim of NA, image-height, throughput, RGB correction or MTF feasibility.

ct20_stop_scan.scope: small STOP scan within first-opening50 alternative; no per-field/per-color refocus
